item.title: MCBB: Mississippi State’s winning streak ends in 97-89 loss at South Carolina
item.description: COLOMBIA, S.C. item.title: MCBB: Southern Miss rallies from 18 down to top Old Dominion 86-81

item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — President Donald Trump said Saturday that he wants a global tariff of 15%, up from 10% he had announced a day earlier after the U.S. Supreme Court struck down many of the far-reaching taxes on imports that he had imposed over the last year. item.title: University of Mississippi Medical Center clinics closed Monday and Tuesday due to cyberattack
item.description: A cyberattack last week is forcing the University of Mississippi Medical Center to keep its clinics closed and cancel all elective procedures on Monday and Tuesday, the academic medical center announced. “Medical Center teams continue to respond to the impact of our recent cyberattacks alongside federal and state agencies and experts in cybersecurity,” UMMC said […]

item.title: Farmers can apply for USDA’s one-time $11 billion bridge payments
item.description: Farmers across the country will soon be able to apply for the U.S. Department of Agriculture’s bridge payments. item.title: Thunder & Lightning: The Competition Steps Up Big Time For Mississippi State Baseball This Week
item.description: It’s been smooth sailing thus far for Mississippi State baseball, but the seas get a little rougher starting this week. Are the Diamond Dawgs prepared for a big step up in competition? Brian Hadad and Robbie Faulk take a look at what’s to come for Brian O’Connor’s squad.
